Warning: flashing content

This page can display flashing colors. Flashing can trigger seizures, migraines, dizziness, or nausea. Do not start it if you or anyone nearby may be sensitive to flashing. Reading the measurements or running the synthetic analysis in the main tool requires no flashing playback.

The live field is intentionally large. Failing examples exceed frequency thresholds and can exceed the area threshold. A stop button and short duration do not make exposure safe.

To test browser capture: share this example tab from Flash Review, then return here and explicitly start playback. Press Escape or Stop at any time. Playback stops after five seconds, if this tab becomes hidden, or if you navigate away. No fullscreen mode is requested.

Expected failures assume the large field exceeds the normative area limit: more than 25% of a 10-degree visual field. A 341 × 256 rectangle at the WCAG 1024 × 768 reference screen is an estimate of that field; more than 21,824 concurrently flashing pixels inside it exceeds 25%. This page does not calibrate physical viewing distance or display geometry.
